DrShoshany.com - Our NYC Chiropractic and Spinal Decompression Center is conveniently located in the NOHO Manhattan in New York City. Our chiropractors are using the latest and most technologically advanced chiropractic techniques to insure long-term results for our clients. We provide effective pain relief for a wide variety of conditions. Dr. Steven Shoshany of NYC Chiropractic in Manhattan specializes in providing gentle, safe and effective Chiropractic care to people of all ages.
Located in Noho NYC 
636 Broadway suite 304  NY NY 10012
Call (212) 645-8151 to schedule an appointment
